Instructions for Use
Device description: The Juniper Pacing System is a cardiac pacing system. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
The Juniper Pacing System is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 1,900 Gauss/cm (19 T/m)
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Coil Type Head Transmit/Receive Coil ONLY
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg ≤ 1.2 W/kg
Maximum active scan time not specified 10 minutes
Scan Regions Only head and lower extremity landmarks are permitted
MR image artifact: the artifact may extend up to 40 mm beyond the implant.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
